task: Brown57 fixed-induced-old-graph capacity at degree cap 9
scope: Inherit the already verified simple 57-point Brown source with 8 vertices of degree 7 and 49 of degree 8. Add h helpers, arbitrary old-helper edges, and arbitrary helper-helper graph H; the old induced graph must stay exactly the source.

historical_exact_scope_check.method: Read parent D2 PROOF/RESULT and source construction/obstruction files; rg Brown57/cap9/degree9/formula terms in research, context, proofs and reviews.
historical_exact_scope_check.finding: Located the old cap8 obstruction and q8/cap9 classical formula comparison, but no existing Brown57-to-cap9 arbitrary-helper capacity proof. No historical queue is resumed.

prediction: Every diameter-at-most-two extension in this scope has h<=15 and order<=72, hence cannot match the inherited public (9,2) order 74 or improve it at 75.
planned_argument: Write s_i for helper i's number of old pins and B=sum_i s_i. Old degree budgets imply B<=8*2+49=65.
All 57 old targets of helper i must lie in N_G[S_i] union the old pin sets of H-neighbors. Counting direct pin targets inside the closed neighborhoods gives 57<=9*s_i+sum_{j adjacent_H i}s_j.
For h>=16 the last right-hand side is maximized over 0<=B<=65 at B=65. Therefore 57*h^2-1170*h+4225<=0. Its value at 16 is 97 and its forward difference is positive for h>=16, contradiction.
failure_checks: H is arbitrary, not necessarily a clique or regular.
Helper-to-old direct adjacency must be counted, and is counted by N_G[S_i].
The old-old edge set is fixed exactly. This proof is not automatically a bound when additional old-old edges are allowed.
Ignoring helper-helper distance obligations only relaxes the model, so a contradiction from helper-old obligations is sufficient.
Order 72 is a necessary upper bound in this fixed-source scope, not an existence claim or global upper bound on N(9,2).

numerical_budget.allowed: small integer and rational arithmetic only

stop: After the proof and one finite arithmetic check, write PROOF/RESULT/TERMINAL and close this fixed-source/public-target entry. Do not enumerate helper graphs or seeds.
